title: DOL H-1B LCA: employers' filed wages per company, occupation (SOC) and metro (WO-036)
source: U.S. Department of Labor, OFLC LCA disclosure data (public, no key)
what_it_is: Wages employers filed for H-1B workers on certified Labor Condition Applications: not offers, not pay received. A floor signal: an employer must pay at least the filed wage.
awaiting_reason: Built 2026-10-20 in an environment that could not reach dol.gov, so the quarter file was not downloaded. The importer and its test fixture are in the repo; CI or the owner runs the command above and commits the result.
